points.name: Visitor Centre day-use parking
points.description: The park directs day-use hikers and backcountry visitors to parking at the Visitor Centre. This is the GIS point for parking, not a claim that the lot or Highway 627 is open today.

points.name: Hattie Cove Visitor Centre
points.description: Park exhibits and staff advice in the visitor season. The centre is seasonal; consult published hours before counting on services.

points.name: Park kiosk area
points.description: Mapped kiosk and rental area. Availability of equipment and on-site staffing changes by season; no current service guarantee.

points.name: Horseshoe Beach
points.description: The sandy Lake Superior shoreline reached from Hattie Cove. It is a visitor landmark, not a surveyed Boardwalk Beach Trail starting point.

points.name: Middle Beach
points.description: Park-listed destination on the Beach Trail shoreline. The pin is a beach location, not a trailhead, access confirmation or recommended cross-country route.

points.name: Southern Headland red chairs
points.description: Parks Canada's red-chair viewpoint on Southern Headland Trail. This is not a trailhead or a shortcut, and the map does not certify trail access.

points.name: Visitor-area picnic spot
points.description: A Parks Canada mapped picnic-area point near the visitor facilities; no claim about current accessibility or services.

safety.statement: Public access points are genuine GIS locations, not paths, turn-by-turn directions, travel times or open-now confirmations.
